title: Mechanical Design Engineer (CAD) – Medical Devices (f/m/d)
description:
Design housings and mechanisms for our diagnostic devices.

What you'll do
- Create 3D models and drawings in Autodesk Inventor
- Select materials and manufacturing processes
- Support prototype builds and test runs

What you bring
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or mechatronics
- 2+ years of CAD design experience
- Knowledge of injection moulding is a plus; medical-device knowledge is helpful
- English; German at B1
